entries.zh: 楦鞋；用鞋楦把鞋撑开、整形
entries.en: to shape shoes on a last; to stretch shoes
to shape shoes on a last

entries.zh: 节省开支；有节制地花钱
entries.en: to economize in spending; to spend moderately

entries.zh: 驱赶魔鬼；驱邪（以祝祷、法术赶走邪祟）
entries.en: to drive away the devil; to conjure away evil
entries.notes: H「捫」与 M「tě soá」音义不合，释义依「煞」及西语 conjurar（驱邪）定夺。

entries.zh: 嫁妆；搬送嫁妆（原义为家用什物，此指妆奁）
entries.en: dowry, trousseau; to carry the bride's dowry
to fit or join two things together

entries.zh: 把两扇窗装配合缝；插合窗扇
entries.notes: H「插插」与 L ajustar 不直接对应，依「两扇窗」语境与 M「bá bá」判为装配、插合。

entries.zh: 算账凑数；结清账目以便付款
entries.en: to reckon up and settle accounts in order to pay
